n: Ports of the lanes: the typical ports of the main routes of the recorded seaborne pairs (the pairs tables, CEPII BACI customs data) and the ports the lane pages name. `n` = pairs that use the port (for a port only the lane pages name: the lane pages that name it), `g` = customs groups it serves (largest first), `lane` = the largest pair that has a lane page (for a port only the lane pages name: the largest lane that names it), `lanes` = the largest lane pages that use it, `asset` = the port asset of the infrastructure layer that is this place (its `locode`): the search opens the asset; `aka` = the other names of that asset that the trade engine and the routes use ("Pusan" for Busan). Only the names and the links are used by the site; no figure is published here.
